property_summary: Calls to transfer must execute one external low-level call per recipient, and the mutant skips them entirely, so the caller's balance of an ERC20 or identifier of those calls never changes, which the original guarantees.
change_summary: Delete the statement '{ (bool _s,) = caddress.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(id, from, _tos[i], v)); require(_s); }' so no transfer occurs.
